# Navigation test dependency

Unmodified plugin and license from
[christoomey/vim-tmux-navigator](https://github.com/christoomey/vim-tmux-navigator/tree/e41c431a0c7b7388ae7ba341f01a0d217eb3a432),
at the revision pinned by `.config/nvim/lazy-lock.json`.

The navigation regression tests load this offline fixture so they do not depend
on a plugin installed in the user's HOME or Neovim data directory.
